{{Top}}
'''Sparkflies''' were small flying [[Insect/Legends|insects]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They had bio-electric luminescent bodies, which were used to signal other members of their [[Species/Legends|species]]. The pointed end of their abdomen could release a debilitating electrical charge. Although a single shock would only leave a mild burn, multiple stings from even a small swarm could [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Human/Legends|Human]].

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Control web|control]] swarms of sparkflies to attack the [[Broken Columns Clan]] and the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] during [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|their conclave]].
